description: Chiffres des comptages de cyclistes sur les voiries de la Communauté d'agglomération - Troyes Champagne Métropole is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Madada. counts made with cyclists on the cycling lanes of Troyes Champagne Métropole via sensors installed on the roads concerned. Coverage: Madada. The portal shows the English title as "Counts of cyclists on roads in the agglomeration community — Troyes Champagne Métropole" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Madada. Its keywords include comptage-velo. The listing shows 5 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2020-03-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
